seoTitle: How to Connect Walmart to Shopify (Sell on Walmart)
metaDescription: Sell your Shopify products on Walmart Marketplace by installing the Walmart integration app, syncing products, and managing orders.
intro: Expanding beyond your own Shopify store to Walmart Marketplace can put your products in front of a much bigger audience. This guide covers how to connect Walmart to Shopify, sync your product catalog, and manage Walmart orders directly from your Shopify admin.

steps.heading: Install the Walmart integration app
steps.body: Search the Shopify App Store for a Walmart integration app and add it to your store.

steps.heading: Connect your Walmart Seller account
steps.body: Log into your Walmart Seller account through the app to link it with your Shopify store.

steps.heading: Sync your products
steps.body: Use the app to sync your Shopify product catalog with your Walmart Marketplace listings.

steps.heading: Manage orders from Shopify
steps.body: Once connected, Walmart orders will appear in your Shopify admin so you can fulfill them alongside your regular orders.

faq.question: Do I need a separate Walmart Seller account?
faq.answer: Yes, you need an approved Walmart Marketplace Seller account before you can connect it to Shopify.

faq.question: Is the Walmart integration app free?
faq.answer: Pricing varies by app, with some offering free tiers and others charging based on order volume or features.

faq.question: Will inventory stay in sync between Walmart and Shopify?
faq.answer: Yes, most integration apps sync inventory levels automatically so stock counts stay accurate across both platforms.

faq.question: Can I fulfill Walmart orders the same way as Shopify orders?
faq.answer: Yes, once synced, Walmart orders appear in your Shopify admin and can be fulfilled using your normal fulfillment process.
